question: True or false: in 2024 South Korea spent more buying kimchi from abroad than it earned selling kimchi abroad?
answer: True. Exports hit a record $163.6 million, but imports, almost all from China, reached $189.9 million, and Korea has run a kimchi deficit most years since 2010. Chinese factory kimchi costs far less, so it fills the free, endlessly refilled side dishes of Korean restaurants.
move: Where a thing is famous from and where it is made are separate questions.
trap: Assuming the dish's homeland must sell more of it than it buys.
